thesis: The podcast argues that despite the availability of advanced technologies like AI, XR, and gaming, these tools have not yet successfully integrated into classrooms to address significant learning loss and inequities exacerbated by the pandemic. It proposes that immersive technologies such as virtual reality can help students develop critical spatial reasoning and abstraction skills necessary for success in STEM fields by transforming abstract math and science concepts into tangible, real-world simulations.
